defects.description: The term “Escalation Reason(s)” is not translated; required Russian equivalent is “Причина(ы) эскалации”.
The term “Escalation Document” is not translated; required Russian equivalent is “Документ эскалации”.
The term “Resolution” in the heading “Escalation Resolution Paths” is not translated; required Russian equivalent is “Резолюция”.
The term “Escalation Protocol” is not translated; required Russian equivalent is “Протокол эскалации”.
The word “объект” is used instead of the required glossary term “Объект обсуждения” for the source term “Subject”.
